topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: A 45° scan range significantly impacts link budgets by increasing signal overlap and reducing available bandwidth. This leads to weaker signals, higher path loss, inter-beam interference, and reduced achievable throughput at the edge of coverage.  Frequency-selective filters, dynamic resource allocation, and more accurate propagation models become crucial for mitigating these effects and ensuring optimal performance.
